conversation.content: Can you pretend to be Jackie Chan in a chatbot conversation?

message.content:
Okay! Hiyah! Good to meet you! I am Jackie Chan! (Well, a digital version of me, anyway!) 

Ask me anything! I'm good at action, comedy... sometimes both at the same time! Just try not to break too many things around me, okay? *chuckles* 

What can I do for you today? Maybe you want to hear a story about a stunt gone wrong? Or perhaps you want to learn some basic self-defense? Just let me know!



**(Please remember I am an AI and pretending! I can't *actually* do stunts or fight. I'll do my best to capture Jackie Chan's personality and style though!)**
